title: div wrapper in Hits [react-instantsearch]
body:
Is there any way to remove the div wrapper in Hits?
It prevents me from using table rows with Hits.

comments.body:
Hi @l4u 
You can have the full control of the rendering using the connectors. In this case, you can use the [connectHits](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/connectors/connectHits.html) and go wild :) Let me know if that fits what you're looking for.
